popCulture.title: Electra
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Electra keeps Strophius as the Phocian king who sheltered the infant Orestes — the foster-father whose house makes Pylades Orestes' brother-in-arms.

popCulture.title: Orestes
popCulture.description: The Oresteian exile begins at Strophius' court — the Phocian king who raised Agamemnon's son beside Pylades until the return to Mycenae.

popCulture.title: Pylades
popCulture.description: Pylades is Strophius' son — the friendship that defines Orestes' nostos starts in the house of the Phocian king.

popCulture.title: Strophius
popCulture.description: King of Phocis, son of Crisus — foster-father of Orestes and father of Pylades in the Oresteian cycle.
